source_title: Parsons hat-trick as Irish beat South Africa again
source_excerpt:
Ireland followed up last week's win in Cape Town with another six-try display
Tries: Tose, Solontsi, Ubisi Con: Cilliers
Tries: King, Parsons 3, Dalton 2 Cons: O'Brien 4
Beibhinn Parsons scored a hat-trick of tries as Ireland closed out their WXV Global Series campaign by securing a historic Test series win over South Africa in Cape Town.
Winger Parsons, the team's all-time leading try-scorer, crossed once in the first half and twice after half-time to lift the Irish to a hard-fought win having fallen behind with 20 minutes left.
Captain Erin King and Aoife Dalton (2) also scored to help Ireland see off the Springboks in another bruising encounter at Athlone Stadium.
Unam Tose, Sizophila Solontsi and Vainah Ubisi crossed for the hosts, who were unable to avenge last week's 40-27 loss at the same venue.
In following up last week's win with another six-try display, Scott Bemand's side become the first Irish senior side to win back-to-back Tests on South African soil.

Having struggled with South Africa's power at times last week, Bemand challenged his players to match their hosts' physicality, but Tose's second-minute score from a line-out drive immediately put the Irish on the back foot.
However, when King and Parsons scored either side of a yellow card for South Africa's Alichia Arries, the momentum appeared to be firmly in Ireland's favour.
But South Africa produced a stout response and reduced the deficit to four points when Solontsi benefited from another driving maul following a sustained spell of pressure from the hosts.
With scrum-half Aoibheann Reilly - drafted into the line-up in Emily Lane's place - sin-binned for an illegal clearout before Solontsi touched down, Ireland cut frustrated figures at the half-time interval.
Chasing a first win over the Irish, South Africa continued to rely on their power game early in the second half and punctured the away side's defence once more when Ubisi forced her way over the line.
Parsons has now scored 29 tries in 40 Ireland caps
That score put South Africa 19-14 up with 20 minutes remaining, and while the Boks had frustrated the Irish attack for large parts of the game, they were unable to stop Parsons surging through for her second try.
South Africa's hopes were further dashed when Jakkie Cilliers was shown a yellow card 10 minutes from time for a dangerous tackle on Irish fly-half Dannah O'Brien.
Within seconds of Cilliers leaving the field, Dalton sprinted through a gap in the South African defence for a converted try that put Ireland two scores clear.
The hosts' hopes of a late fightback were crushed when Parsons dotted down for her treble, improving her Test record to 29 tries in 40 caps.
Having regained control, Ireland's hunger for more tries was rewarded when Dalton crossed in the corner in the closing minutes to cap the series-sealing win.
After losing their WXV opener to the United States, Ireland bounced back to beat Japan and South Africa in their remaining matches, while they also saw off the former in a standalone Test in Cork.
South Africa: Byrhandre Dolf; Jakkie Cilliers, Maceala Samboya, Shiniqwa Lamprecht, Alichia Arries; Mary Zulu, Unam Tose; Yonela Ngxingolo, Lindelwa Gwala, Xoliswa Khuzwayo, Vainah Ubisi, Danelle Lochner; Sizophila Solontsi (capt), Catha Jacobs, Aseza Hele.
Replacements: Anushka Groenewald, Anuschka Ekron, Thandile Mazwi, Nomsa MokwaI, Aphiwe Ngwevu, Lerato Makua, Insaaf Levy, Maria Tshiremba.
Ireland: Niamh Gallagher; Beibhinn Parsons, Anna McGann, Aoife Dalton, Robyn O'Connor; Dannah O'Brien, Aoibheann Reilly; Linda Djougang, Neve Jones, Eilis Cahill, Jane Clohessy, Dorothy Wall, Fiona Tuite-O'Sullivan, Erin King (capt), Brittany Hogan.
Replacements: Beth Buttimer, Niamh O'Dowd, Sophie Barrett, Grace Moore, Jemima Adams Verling, Emily Lane, Eve Higgins, Stacey Flood.

## ऐतिहासिक टेस्ट सीरीज जीत

आयरलैंड की महिला रग्बी टीम ने केपटाउन में खेले गए मुकाबले में दक्षिण अफ्रीका को हराकर डब्ल्यूएक्सवी (WXV) ग्लोबल सीरीज अभियान का शानदार अंत किया। विंगर बीबिह्न पार्सन्स ने इस मैच में तीन ट्राइ (हैट्रिक) करके अपनी टीम की जीत में अहम भूमिका निभाई। इस जीत के साथ ही स्कॉट बेमंड की कोचिंग वाली आयरलैंड टीम ने दक्षिण अफ्रीकी जमीन पर लगातार दो टेस्ट मैच जीतने वाली पहली सीनियर आयरिश टीम बनने का गौरव हासिल किया है।

## मैच के मुख्य आकर्षण

- **पार्सन्स का शानदार प्रदर्शन:** बीबिह्न पार्सन्स ने मैच के दौरान एक ट्राई पहले हाफ में और दो ट्राई दूसरे हाफ के बाद किए। इसके साथ ही उनके अंतरराष्ट्रीय करियर में 40 मैचों में कुल 29 ट्राइ हो गए हैं।
- **अन्य स्कोरर:** कप्तान एरिन किंग और Aoife Dalton (दो बार) ने भी स्कोरशीट में योगदान दिया।
- **दक्षिण अफ्रीका की चुनौती:** मेजबान टीम की ओर से Unam Tose, Sizophila Solontsi और Vainah Ubisi ने ट्राई किए और एक समय पर दक्षिण अफ्रीका ने मैच में 19-14 की बढ़त भी बना ली थी।

## खेल का घटनाक्रम

मैच की शुरुआत में दक्षिण अफ्रीका ने अपनी शारीरिक ताकत का प्रदर्शन करते हुए शुरुआती बढ़त बनाई। हालांकि, पहले हाफ के दौरान दक्षिण अफ्रीका की Alichia Arries को येलो कार्ड मिलने के बाद आयरलैंड को गति मिली। खेल के अंतिम चरणों में दक्षिण अफ्रीकी खिलाड़ी Jakkie Cilliers को खतरनाक टैकल के लिए येलो कार्ड दिखाया गया, जिसका फायदा उठाकर आयरिश टीम ने अपनी बढ़त को मजबूत किया और अंततः छह ट्राई के साथ मैच अपने नाम किया।

## आगे की जानकारी और सत्यापन

इस मैच और WXV ग्लोबल सीरीज के परिणामों से जुड़ी आधिकारिक जानकारी तथा स्कोरकार्ड के लिए रग्बी यूनियन की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट या खेल समाचार पोर्टल्स पर प्रकाशित रिपोर्टों को देखा जा सकता है।

en_body:
## Historic Victory in Cape Town

Beibhinn Parsons scored a hat-trick of tries to help Ireland secure a historic Test series victory over South Africa with a six-try display at Athlone Stadium in Cape Town. According to the published report, the result marks the first time a senior Ireland side has won back-to-back Tests on South African soil.

Head coach Scott Bemand's side concluded their WXV Global Series campaign with the win, bouncing back from an opening loss to the United States by subsequently defeating Japan and securing two victories against South Africa.

## Match Summary and Scoring

South Africa opened the scoring early through a second-minute line-out drive by Unam Tose. Despite trailing 19-14 with 20 minutes remaining after a try from South Africa's Vainah Ubisi, Ireland rallied.

* **Ireland Tries:** Erin King, Beibhinn Parsons (3), Aoife Dalton (2)
* **Ireland Conversions:** Dannah O'Brien (4)
* **South Africa Tries:** Unam Tose, Sizophila Solontsi, Vainah Ubisi
* **South Africa Conversions:** Jakkie Cilliers

Parsons crossed once in the first half and twice after the break, bringing her international record to 29 tries in 40 caps. Captain Erin King and Aoife Dalton also contributed tries to seal the match.

## Disciplinary Incidents

Both teams experienced periods with players in the sin bin during the bruising encounter:

* South Africa's Alichia Arries received a yellow card in the first half.
* Ireland scrum-half Aoibheann Reilly was sin-binned for an illegal clearout just before half-time.
* South Africa's Jakkie Cilliers was shown a yellow card with 10 minutes remaining for a dangerous tackle on Dannah O'Brien.

## Practical Implications

* Ireland successfully wrapped up their WXV Global Series fixtures with consecutive victories against the Springboks.
* South Africa remains winless against Ireland following two consecutive defeats at Athlone Stadium, including a 40-27 result the previous week.
